PRODUCT PORTFOLIO

Precision Connections for Industrial Piping.

Industrial flanges provide secure connections between pipes, valves, equipment, and other piping components. United Piping's portfolio covers carbon steel, stainless steel, duplex stainless steel, and alloy steel flange materials.
